Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Ralph Hefferline was a psychology professor at the University of Southern California based on a search-results snippet, without verifying the affiliation using authoritative sources. Hefferline was a psychology professor at Columbia University, which is in New York City. This misidentification led the Planner to look up USC’s location and produce the incorrect city (Los Angeles) instead of the correct one (New York City).
